watches.name: DEEP DIVE E11 Limited Edition ◇ Automatic Dive Watch - 44mm - Black Dial
watches.description: The Deep Dive returns - a final edition of 10 watches The Enoksen Deep Dive Limited Edition traces its heritage back to one watch that helped define our brand: the original Deep Dive E01/A. That watch quickly earned a reputation for combining uncompromising capability with understated Scandinavian design. This Edition builds on that legacy, shaped by customer feedback, real-world experience and our own determination to make an already exceptional watch even better. Serious 1,000-metre dive watch - balanced for everyday wear The result is a serious professional dive watch. Water resistant to 100 ATM (1,000 metres) , the Deep Dive has been engineered to perform in environments most watches will never encounter. Yet despite its extraordinary capability, it remains comfortable, balanced and perfectly suited to everyday wear. Nothing about the Deep Dive is accidental Every detail has been carefully considered. The screw-down crown has been repositioned to 4 o'clock, making it more comfortable on the wrist while providing greater protection against accidental knocks. The dial was developed through direct consultation and field testing, resulting in a layout that remains exceptionally clear and legible in demanding conditions, where a quick glance can make all the difference. Beneath the surface, the Deep Dive is every bit as impressive. A scratch-resistant ceramic bezel, sapphire crystal, helium escape valve, two purpose-built straps and the renowned Swiss-made Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement combine to create a watch designed not for the display cabinet, but for a lifetime of dependable service. Swiss powered. Hand built in Tønder. Hand built in Tønder, Denmark, every Deep Dive is assembled, regulated and tested by our own watchmakers before leaving for its new owner. It has earned the trust of professional saturation divers and enthusiasts around the world because it was never designed to be a fashion accessory. It was designed to be relied upon. Manual winding. Automatic winding with ball bearing Additional Features Quick-set calendar Hacking Winding Bi-directional self-winding via rotor Power Reserve 44 hours Capability beyond the ordinary Helium Escape Valve Built for the world's toughest dives The Enoksen Deep Dive is guaranteed water resistant to 1,000 metres - a depth rating that surpasses many watches costing ten times as much. Its integrated helium escape valve allows the watch to safely withstand the extreme pressures encountered during saturation diving, the specialist technique used by commercial divers working at great depth. Whether you ever venture below the waves or not, it is reassuring to know your watch was built with genuine professional capability. Self-winding, dependable and proven in demanding environments, it offers a power reserve of approximately 44 hours when fully wound. watches.name: DIVE II E12/B ◇ Automatic Dive Watch - 39mm - Black Dial Edition
watches.description: The Enoksen Dive II E12/B Black Dial Edition is a 39mm automatic skin diver watch inspired by the clean dive-watch silhouettes of the 1950s and 1960s. Limited to a single series of 100 pieces worldwide, it combines compact proportions, strong contrast, and real water capability in a watch made to be worn. The matte black dial gives the E12/B a more understated, instrument-like character, while the 120-click unidirectional 12-hour aluminium bezel can be used for simple timing or tracking a second time zone. The watch features a solid 316L stainless steel case, screw-down crown and caseback, 300m / 1000ft / 30 ATM water resistance, and a domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal. Inside is the Seiko NH35A automatic movement with 24 jewels, hacking seconds, quick-set date, and approximately 41 hours of power reserve. Each watch is assembled and calibrated in Denmark for dependable everyday performance. The case measures 39mm in diameter, 41.2mm including the crown, 47.5mm lug-to-lug, and 14.4mm in thickness, with a 20mm lug width. The compact case profile is well suited to those who normally wear watches in the 38–40mm range. Two interchangeable straps are included: Enoksen’s black natural rubber strap for the water and a burgundy herringbone woven single-pass strap for everyday wear. Backed by a 2-year international warranty and free worldwide shipping.

watches.name: FLY E03/P ◇ Hand Wound Field Watch (W10) - 38mm
watches.description: A Proper Field Watch. Nothing More. Nothing Less. Some watches chase trends. Others chase specifications. The Enoksen Fly E03/P was built for something else entirely: reliability without dependency. Inspired by original 1960s military service watches issued under GG-W-113, this is a mechanically wound field watch assembled and tested in Europe, using construction methods that predate batteries, satellites, apps, and updates. You wind it. It runs. That’s the point . Why This Watch Exists In the early 1960s, military timepieces were designed to survive real conditions: shock, dirt, moisture, neglect - and still keep accurate time. That thinking has largely disappeared. The Fly E03/P brings it back. No battery No electronics No fragile crystal No spring bars to fail Just steel, gears, and intent. For collectors, it’s historically faithful. For daily wear, it’s reassuringly simple. For those who value preparedness, it’s a timekeeper that works independently of everything else. Authentic by Design This watch replicates three defining features of original 1960s service watches, deliberately and unapologetically: Plexiglass (Acrylic) Crystal - Chosen not for hardness, but for survivability. Acrylic flexes under impact and can be polished back to clarity in minutes - even in the field. Fixed Solid Lugs - No spring bars. No weak points. Your strap will fail before the watch does. Hand-Wound Mechanical Movement 17 jewels - Manually wound. No battery to leak, die, or become unavailable. Wind it every day or two - a small ritual that keeps you connected to the machine. See how it's done here . Built for Use, Not Display The sandblasted 316L steel case avoids reflections and unnecessary polish. The dial is matte black, high-contrast, and instantly legible. The lumen is present, functional, and restrained. Exactly as it should be. This is not a watch that shouts. It shows up. A Watch for an Uncertain World There’s a reason hand-wound watches were trusted for critical missions, including early spaceflight, long before anyone knew how electronics would behave under extreme conditions. The Fly E03/P follows the same logic. If you believe in owning fewer things - but better ones, this watch makes sense. Specifications Model : Enoksen Fly E03/P Case Diameter : 38 mm (41.3 mm incl. crown) Thickness : 12.5 mm Lug width : 20 mm Lug-to-Lug : 46 mm Material : Sandblasted 316L stainless steel Caseback : Screw-down, engraved serial number Crystal : Plexiglass (acrylic) Dial : Matte black with high-contrast Arabic numerals Super-Luminova Movement : Hand-wound Cal. 2650, 17 jewels, 21,600 beats per minute. Approx. 36-hour power reserve Water Resistance : 5 ATM / 50 m Lugs : Fixed solid bars (original military specification) Strap : Single-pass tactical nylon (black) Packaging : Enoksen gift box. Enoksen black suede pouch

watches.name: FLY E03/M ◇ Swiss Automatic Dirty Dozen Field Watch - 36mm - Black Dial
watches.description: The Enoksen Fly E03/M is a Swiss automatic Dirty Dozen field watch with a black dial, white markers and compact 36mm case proportions. It is the most complete version in the Dirty Dozen range, combining the same restrained military field-watch design with a Swiss Sellita movement and a more refined ownership experience. The watch is made from 316L stainless steel and features 100m water resistance, Swiss Super-LumiNova and a domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal for scratch resistance and everyday clarity. It is powered by a Sellita SW260 31-jewel automatic movement with hacking, fine-tuned in-house for optimal accuracy. Although compact on paper, the 36mm case, 43.2mm lug-to-lug and military case shape make the watch wear slightly larger than the numbers suggest. The 18mm strap width keeps the proportions balanced and makes the watch easy to pair with compatible 18mm straps. The included single-pass and dual-pass straps lift the case slightly, helping the watch feel centred on the wrist. If you normally wear watches in the 38-40mm range, the E03/M should still feel natural. Most wrists from 15-20cm will find it secure and easy to wear. Supplied with a brown soft leather strap, a khaki seatbelt NATO strap, an additional beige canvas strap and a two-year warranty.

watches.name: Aeschbach 1944 ◇ Automatic Dress Watch - 36mm
watches.description: Designed in 1944. Finally made to be worn. A timepiece more than 80 years in the making, the Aeschbach 1944 is the watch history intended - but never realised until now.
